subject: English
passage: Loanwords are words adopted from one language into another with little or no modification. ______ terms have become especially common in the vocabulary of modern economics (think of laissez-faire or entrepreneur).
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The convention being tested is pronoun-antecedent agreement. The plural demonstrative pronoun "these" agrees in number with the plural antecedent "loanwords."

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect because the singular indefinite pronoun "each" doesn't agree in number with the plural antecedent "loanwords."
